# Commits of linux-6.1.y that plinius-kernel 6.1.192-3 has as ancestors (merged) but whose
# changes it did not take, to keep the interface of the prebuilt vendor modules: f2fs, arm_scmi,
# DAMON, a few reverts, CVE-2024-38620 (HCI_AMP removal) and files kept at the ACK state.
# tools/publish-kernel-cves.sh manifest KERNEL_MISSING=<this file>: their CVEs stay listed.
# Not in this list although their change differs from linux-6.1.y: bab016bb80d7 (fscrypt,
# CVE-2026-68147; ACK carries it as BACKPORT c3e0109ec) and 4987d336abf3 (cpuset,
# CVE-2026-93150; applied in the 6.1.192 merge c74855c1c). Both fixes are in the tree.
